description: Read an exact public person by case-sensitive kind and ID, with canonical citation. currentCampaign is null once the race is decided; campaigns lists real candidacies: a retired or duplicate storage row is never listed, and a re-elected official shows the race they won. Each campaign carries status (active, result_pending once election day has passed without a call, ended) and outcome: won, lost or withdrawn only when the race result or a recorded reason says so, else null. party is null with partyNote when not recorded (never "Unknown"). contact carries the official website, plus office phone and email when a public source published them (phoneSource and emailSource say where), or null. photo.url is the reviewed portrait shown on the profile, or null. heldOffice.place names the town or county for a local office. about (officials) holds published, sourced profile facts: bio, background, education, birthYear, campaignSite, socials and positions, each with its source host and URL, or null when not found. Only published, sourced values. Positions are the person's own words with a link. Voting records are not included.
